new_assets.construction: Use case illustration-story. A reusable educational explainer illustration on a genuinely transparent background: a modest California housing construction site with three compact newly built homes at different stages, one finished terracotta-roof house, one exposed timber frame, one foundation. Two small clearly drawn construction workers wearing proper hard hats discuss a rolled building plan beside the framing; neutral calm expressions. Small stacks of timber and a wheelbarrow. Wide landscape isolated vignette, ample transparent margin, no text, logos, numbers, labels, charts, or signs. Polished editorial ink and watercolor in an artist's sketchbook: varied charcoal-blue ink outlines, delicate crosshatching, warm ivory unpainted areas, translucent granular sage-green, ochre and terracotta washes. Expressive hand-drawn architectural detail, natural human proportions. Friendly yet serious public-information illustration, neither glossy 3D nor corporate flat vector clipart. All structures and people fully in frame. No expansive sky, background landscape, or colored rectangular backdrop.
new_assets.voter: Use case illustration-story. Create an isolated editorial ink-and-watercolor vignette for a neutral voter-information video, on genuine transparent background. A thoughtful adult woman with short curly dark hair and light-medium warm skin sits at a small wooden kitchen table, reading several unlettered papers with one hand near her chin and holding a pencil in the other. A plain closed notebook, simple ceramic mug and small calculator lie on the table. Her expression is calmly considering information, not anxious, angry or celebratory. Show her complete upper body, table surface and partial table legs, with enough breathing room all around. No other people, no speech bubbles, no text, no numbers, no ballot marks, no political imagery or party symbols. Artist's sketchbook style: varied charcoal-blue ink contours, delicate crosshatching and authentic translucent watercolor pigment grain. Restrained sage/teal blouse, ochre notebook, terracotta mug, mostly unpainted areas. Natural anatomy and expressive face, polished magazine illustration rather than corporate clipart or photorealism. This same person will appear considering reasons both for and against a policy.
